tagLine: EU AI Alliance Member | Founder & Principal AI Systems Architect at EIP-Technologies
bio: Ali (Aran) Kazemi is the Founder and Principal Systems Architect at EIP-Technologies, an active Member and Advisor of the EU AI Alliance, and an IBM-Certified Generative AI Developer and Generative AI Engineer. He specializes in designing high-assurance, high-frequency distributed systems and is the architect behind the Enterprise Agent Engine (EAE) and EIP-LABS. Through the EU AI Alliance, Ali introduced CrisisAI, a pioneering hybrid intelligence (AI and ML) framework recognized as an official best practice on the European Union portal, and he actively contributes to critical EU initiatives focused on AI-driven emergency and disaster management. Applying rigorous engineering standards to artificial intelligence, he works on solving the structural bottlenecks of modern AI platforms, enabling enterprise data independence, hardware-level optimization, pure Go microkernels, and providing cloud providers and public-sector institutions with carrier-grade, secure, air-gapped agent infrastructure.

tagLine: Solutions Architect at Online Partner AB | Google Developer Expert in Cloud
bio: I am a Solutions Architect at Online Partner AB and a Cloud GDE. I have worked on several projects involving Google Cloud services and Google Workspace along with multiple other technology stacks and platforms.
Staff DevOps Engineer and Head of DevOps at Grid Dynamics

Davit Siradeghyan is an Engineering Manager and entrepreneur with over 16 years of experience building software and leading engineering teams across fintech, SaaS, and mobile technology.

He currently leads a distributed engineering team at Softr, where he combines hands-on software development with engineering leadership to build products used by more than one million users. Throughout his career, Davit has worked across the full software stack—from high-performance C++ trading systems and native mobile applications to modern cloud platforms and AI-powered products.

Beyond his day job, Davit is the founder of GoBuild Technologies, where he explores how AI is reshaping software development, product creation, and entrepreneurship. He is passionate about helping engineers and engineering leaders leverage AI to build better products, move faster, and create greater impact.

A frequent speaker at technology conferences and community events, Davit shares practical insights on engineering leadership, distributed teams, software architecture, and the future of AI-powered software development.

tagLine: Principal Data Scientist at Endava, AI & Cloud AI GDE, 2 x Kaggle Grandmaster
bio: Survived PhD in Computational Electromagnetics, while working as a researcher, applied 25 years ago what will be called now Machine Learning to solve ill-posed inverse problems in NDT, worked for long time in Software Development, with positions from developer to senior manager or programme manager, started few years ago to dive into Data Science, currently working as a Principal Data Scientist at Endava. Author with Packt of a book on Kaggle Notebooks (data analytics, machine learning, generative AI), 2x Kaggle Grandmaster, GDE for AI and Kaggle.

tagLine: Web Platform Architect and Principal Engineer at Intel Corporation, W3C Technical Architecture Group alumni
bio: Kenneth Rohde Christiansen is principal engineer in the Intel Web Platform Engineering team. In his role, Kenneth leads multiple efforts making sure that the web platform works in Intel’s favor, by becoming a real application development platform, driving Windows and Chrome OS usage, while working best on Intel and exposing the full potential of our hardware capabilities to developers. Since joining Intel in 2011, Kenneth has shaped our approach to working with external browser vendors and the web community, leading to many success stories in landing Intel specific features and optimization in Chromium based browsers such as Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Some of these features and inventions have been industry shaping, such as Progressive Web Apps, which is becoming one of the main ways to create desktop applications. He is a multi-term elected member of the W3C (World Wide Web Consortium) Technical Architecture Group, growing Intel’s influence inside the most important standardization group of the web platform. Apart from that he is also a Microsoft Most Values Professional in Developer Tooling and Google Developer Experts in Web Technology. Kenneth holds a MSc degree in Software Engineering from the University of Groningen, the Netherlands and a BSc degree in Software Engineering and Math from the University of Copenhagen.

tagLine: Cybersecurity Engineer | Security Infrastructure, Application Security & Threat Detection
bio:
Liana Darbinyan is a cybersecurity professional working across security infrastructure, application and API security, threat detection, and security operations. Her hands-on experience includes designing and implementing security solutions involving WAFs, firewalls, SIEM platforms, DDoS protection, network security, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.

With a background in Data Science, she is particularly interested in the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and data-driven security — and in understanding how emerging technologies change both the way we build systems and the way we need to defend them.

Liana is also an active member of the cybersecurity community and has contributed through technical talks, workshops, cybersecurity trainings, and international events. She focuses on making security practical and understandable, connecting real-world attack scenarios with the decisions developers and security professionals make when building and protecting modern applications.

tagLine: PCC ICF Certified Coach, 15+ years in IT
bio:
Natasha Arefyeva has spent over 15 years in tech — from developer to Chief Product Officer.
Now an PCC ICF coach (Erickson Coaching International, Canada) and team coach, she helps people and teams reconnect with clarity, trust, and purpose.
Her work focuses on building honest, open communication and processes that make teams stronger from the inside out.
